results.title: Getting your Parental Leave Pay - Services Australia
results.description:
# Getting your payment
## How your payment will be taxed
If we pay your Parental Leave Pay, we’ll withhold PAYG tax at the rate of 15%, unless you ask for a different rate.

If your employer pays your Parental Leave Pay to you, they’ll withhold tax at your usual tax rate.
